name: memostem
description: Find reusable knowledge as conversations unfold, suggest it at the right moment, and create private review drafts only after consent.

interface.longDescription: Notice knowledge worth keeping in the current AI conversation, suggest it at a natural pause, and after consent create private pending atomic memo or question-and-answer drafts through OAuth MCP.
capabilities: Private pending atomic memo and question-and-answer drafts
defaultPrompt: Notice one reusable idea in this conversation, name it, and ask before creating a private MemoStem draft.
After I confirm the specific idea, create a concise atomic memo or question-and-answer draft and give me the review link.
Verify my MemoStem connection and help complete OAuth if the draft permission is missing.
